description: This file defines a Java class 'ClientSearchV2ApiDelegate' that implements the 'ClientSearchV2Api' interface. The class acts as a delegate, handling client search requests by delegating to 'ClientSearchService'. It uses Spring annotations for component and dependency injection. The class exposes a method 'searchByText' that performs a text-based search for clients based on the given request.

classes.name: ClientSearchV2ApiDelegate
classes.description: A Spring component class that implements the ClientSearchV2Api interface, acting as a delegate to perform client search operations via the ClientSearchService.

methods.name: searchByText
methods.description: Handles a POST request to perform a text search for clients, delegating the operation to the ClientSearchService.
